about_the_game:
Creator:

  • My girlfriend and I dropped out of university to start developing games. She handles the designs, while I take care of the programming.

  • To support us, please add to your Wishlist now :))

Can You Survive in a World Without Trust?

Experience a 1-8 player Multiplayer co-op party game with Active Ragdoll mechanics and physics-based interactions! In a post-apocalyptic world devastated by a zombie outbreak, you’ll soon realize that your biggest enemy isn’t just the zombies:

Doubt.

Every player starts as a human. Your mission is simple: Survive, gather supplies, and establish a safe zone with your team. But as time passes, the infection spreads silently, and even your closest friend might be hiding a secret...

When infected, a player loses control of their actions and starts attacking teammates unwillingly. You never know when, where, or who will be infected next. The scariest part? The longer an infected player hides their condition, the stronger a zombie they become!

Who Can You Trust?

  • Stay human, cooperate with your team, recruit NPCs to your group, or loot them for resources.

  • If infected, conceal your identity, evolve into a stronger zombie, and sabotage your team from within.

Arm Yourself, Use Your Wits, and Fight to Survive!

From melee weapons to ranged firearms, a variety of combat options await you. Manage your resources wisely, take down enemies, and prove yourself as the strongest survivor!

Each match lasts 40-45 minutes, but your choices will determine its outcome.

Can you trust your best friend? What if they’ve been infected and are keeping it a secret? What will you do?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 - AMD Ryzen 5 1600 AF
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 280 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F - AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX

short_description: You have to be a team to survive. But!!! Can you trust your best friend? What if they're infected and hiding it? What will you do with them? Multiplayer co-op party game for 1-8 players. Challenges you to survive by betraying your team.
